statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The denial reason code is CO-197
The diagnosis codes are I48.0 and I49.5
The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of the dual rhythm disturbance
The claim was denied for missing prior authorization
